name: hud_ui_save_load_entry_is_newer_than

known_limits: Local VC5 COFF target hud_ui_save_load_entry_is_newer_than passes for 0x434660 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x434660 validates fastcall ECX=self, EDX=other, FILETIME fields at offset 0x14, CompareFileTime(&self->ftLastWriteTime, &other->ftLastWriteTime), and a zero-extended return of CompareFileTime > 0.
